effective.basis: TCG release of the printing carrying the PSCT text (DPKB-EN033 as reprinted in the Silver Dragon Value Box)

changes.historical_text: Discard 1 card from your hand. Downgrade all Monster Cards in your hand by 2 Levels until the End Phase of the turn this card is activated.
changes.modern_text: Discard 1 card; until the End Phase, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).
changes.summary: Wording modernisation across v0 (DCR-053) -> v1 (DPKB-EN033) -> v2, including the added '(even after they are Summoned)' clarification; both the GOAT and the modern script already register the -2 EFFECT_UPDATE_LEVEL with RESET_TOFIELD excluded, so the reduction always survived the Summon, and the duration remains 'until the End Phase' throughout.

effective.basis: TCG release of the first printing carrying the 'for the rest of this turn' text (LCKC-EN040, Legendary Collection Kaiba Mega Pack)

changes.historical_text: Discard 1 card; until the End Phase, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).
changes.modern_text: Discard 1 card; for the rest of this turn, reduce the Levels of all monsters in your hand by 2 (even after they are Summoned).
changes.summary: Functional erratum: the duration changed from 'until the End Phase' to 'for the rest of this turn'. goat/c504700039.lua registers an extra EFFECT_TYPE_FIELD+EFFECT_TYPE_CONTINUOUS effect on EVENT_PHASE+PHASE_END that fires as the End Phase begins and raises a custom event, and each affected monster carries a companion continuous effect that Resets its -2 EFFECT_UPDATE_LEVEL on that event - so the Level reduction is already gone during the End Phase. The modern script omits that machinery and relies on RESET_PHASE|PHASE_END alone, which expires only once the End Phase has ended, so the reduction still applies during the End Phase.

review.notes: Verified by reading goat/c504700039.lua and official/c23265313.lua in full. The GOAT script's upstream comment, 'The level reset is treated as a continuous effect', names exactly the mechanism that distinguishes 'until the End Phase' from 'for the rest of this turn'; the same companion-effect machinery is duplicated in the EVENT_TO_HAND handler so cards returned to hand later in the turn behave identically. All other diff lines (REASON_COST|REASON_DISCARD vs +, RESETS notation) are value-identical. The GOAT cdb text matches lineage v0 (DCR-053, 2003-12-01) exactly, so the chain starts there; both the GOAT and Edison snapshots therefore sit on the historical implementation, which is correct for their 'until the End Phase' printings. The second upstream code 511002540 is 'Cost Down (Anime)' (no discard cost) and is excluded rather than folded in as a variant.
